target.role: repair tail-only evaluation bias by reassessing known PARKED identities across the full non-protected STRANGE GAIT journey
target.position: Whole journey. Preserve Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal handoffs; Truth in Noise → Transparency and all other non-frozen boundaries remain available.
target.purpose: Reassess the exact Run 51 identities whose earlier verdicts inherited a post-Stardancer slot. Test their strongest plausible current placements across the whole journey.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.

proposedPlacements.position: Between Jayson Wynters — Tehutis Law and CHANCEKNOT — Fragments
proposedPlacements.purpose: Test a glitched/stuttered-vocal constant-build stage between groove re-grounding and Fragments' driving re-escalation.

proposedPlacements.position: Between Inspired Groove — Truth in Noise and Linear System — Transparency
proposedPlacements.purpose: Test whether its constant-build construction makes the entry into the protected trio more deliberate without claiming the disputed Transparency tempo proves flow.

requestedIdentity.fitHypothesis: Perc Trax attributes a glitched, stuttered vocal and a construction that constantly builds to Aurifex Rex. That supports structural freedom but does not establish bodily pull, intensity or exact transition behavior.

evidence.attributedDescription: Perc Trax says Aurifex Rex is built around a glitched and stuttered vocal and constantly builds.
evidence.craftConvention: A continually developing track can be useful before an established rise or block if it strengthens intent rather than simply stacking escalation.
evidence.editorialInterpretation: Potential Tehutis→Fragments development step or entry into the trio; actual attention and pulse effects remain unknown.

proposedPlacements.position: Between Rene Wise — Cave and Sciahri — Too Much Time
proposedPlacements.purpose: Test a stable Detroit-pad/kick-bass foundation as a bridge from the controlled opening into the more physical middle.

proposedPlacements.position: Between Inspired Groove — Truth in Noise and Linear System — Transparency
proposedPlacements.purpose: Test a foundation-led production-world change before the protected trio, while treating the label's cross-context utility claim as description rather than proof.

requestedIdentity.fitHypothesis: Perc Trax attributes deep Detroit-inspired pads and a solid kick/bass foundation to Nostalgia, plus claimed usefulness in different set contexts. This makes it a plausible straight/foundation track inside STRANGE GAIT's broad lens, but the volume-fit and transition evidence are weaker than for the more rhythmically specific candidates.

evidence.attributedDescription: Perc Trax says Nostalgia combines deep Detroit-inspired pads with a rock-solid kick and bass foundation and can work in early or peak-time sets.
evidence.craftConvention: A stable foundation can make a deliberate bridge or reset, but generic flexibility does not prove a specific long-form need.
evidence.editorialInterpretation: Potential Cave→Too Much Time bridge or pre-trio foundation stage; exact pulse, pressure and contribution remain unknown.
